actions.green: No material change. Keep supplies rotated.
actions.yellow: Strategic warning sign. Top up and rotate water, food and batteries.
actions.orange: Operational warning sign. Fill water, charge everything, fuel the car, get cash.
actions.red: Possible widespread outage. Switch to your household plan and tune to your local emergency broadcaster.
